name: The Golden Idol Saga
summary:
The Golden Idol series is a new type of detective game that allows you to think and investigate freely. Discover clues, identify victims and suspects, and unearth the mystery of the Golden Idol - an ancient artifact that wields unfathomable power.

Its existence has perplexed those who have witnessed its abilities - and is a myth among those who haven’t. Untangle the web of mysteries for yourself in Golden Idol - The Complete Saga.

This bundle includes the complete Golden Idol story - including the original The Case of the Golden Idol, both of its devious expansions The Spider of Lanka and The Lemurian Vampire, as well as The Rise of the Golden Idol, and all four upcoming DLC expansions.
